title: Bluegate Business Storage Account Terms — Account Holding and Eligible Profiles
content:
**1. One account per business profile.** A business profile may hold one Bluegate Business Storage Account, and that account covers all of the business's agreements. The limit is 1 account per business profile.

**2. Changing program.** A business that wants another program changes program on its existing Bluegate Business Storage Account.

**3. Who may apply.** Only a profile whose customer type is business may apply for a Bluegate Business Storage Account. The customer type is the one recorded on the customer profile of the applicant, as held in the company's system records; the record on the profile that is applying decides.

## Clauses restated

| Situation of the profile (as the records show it) | Effect under the terms |
|---|---|
| Customer type is business; the profile holds no Bluegate Business Storage Account | The profile may apply |
| Customer type is business; the profile already holds a Bluegate Business Storage Account | The limit of 1 account per profile is reached; a different program is taken by changing program on the existing account |
| Customer type is not business | The profile may not apply |

## Points of judgement

- *Does one account cover agreements held at different times or of different kinds?* Clause 1 says the one account covers all of the business's agreements; there is no second account for some of them.
- *What decides whether a profile is a business?* The customer type recorded on the applicant's own customer profile in the company's records.
- *Hypothetical:* a business profile already on Bluegate Business Plus wants Bluegate Business Pro. Under clause 2 the change is made on the existing account, which stays the profile's 1 account.
